name: Lácacséke (Hungary)
description: Quartered yellow and blue, with yellow in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lácacséke (a quartered shield of yellow and blue with stags and hearts, within a green wreath) above a scroll inscribed LÁCACSÉKE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lácacséke arms with wreath and scroll
